## Service Verticals

### 1. Pest & Termite Control
Bucksworth provides comprehensive pest and termite control for homes and businesses across Phoenix and Tucson, Arizona. Licensed technicians use EPA-approved treatments to eliminate Arizona's toughest pests year-round.

#### Scorpion Control
Arizona bark scorpions are the most venomous scorpion in North America. Our targeted scorpion control program includes blacklight inspections, perimeter sealing, and residual treatments that create a protective barrier around your home. We eliminate existing populations and prevent new ones from entering.

#### Termite Treatment
Arizona termites cause millions in damage annually. Our termite programs include Sentricon baiting systems, liquid barrier treatments (Termidor), spot treatments for drywood termites, and pre-construction treatments for new builds. Every treatment includes a warranty and annual re-inspection.

#### Termite Warranty Registration
Purchased a new-construction home with a Bucksworth pre-treat? Register your termite warranty and lock in our Termite and Pest Control bundle starting at $49/month with a 3-year price guarantee. Transfer your builder warranty seamlessly and add ongoing protection.

#### Roach Elimination
Our roach elimination program uses gel baits, growth regulators, and residual sprays to break the breeding cycle. We target German roaches in kitchens and bathrooms and American/sewer roaches at entry points. Most infestations are eliminated within 2-3 treatments.

#### Ant Control
Arizona is home to fire ants, harvester ants, and carpenter ants that damage property and deliver painful stings. Our ant control targets colonies at the source with granular baits and perimeter treatments.

#### Spider Prevention
Black widows and brown recluse spiders thrive in Arizona. Our spider prevention program includes web removal, crack and crevice treatments, perimeter spraying, and reducing insect prey that attracts spiders.

#### Rodent Exclusion
Pack rats, roof rats, and mice cause electrical damage, contamination, and health risks. Our rodent exclusion program includes trapping, removal, sanitization, and physical sealing of all entry points.

#### Bed Bug Treatment
Our bed bug program uses a combination of heat treatments and targeted chemical applications to eliminate all life stages. We treat mattresses, furniture, baseboards, and wall voids.

#### Mosquito Control
Arizona's monsoon season creates ideal mosquito breeding conditions. Our mosquito program includes backyard fogging, larvicide treatments, and barrier sprays on vegetation.

#### Bee & Wasp Removal
Africanized honey bees and paper wasps are aggressive in Arizona. Our team safely removes hives and nests from walls, eaves, trees, and structures. We relocate honey bees when possible.

### 2. Air Conditioning & Heating
Bucksworth is a licensed HVAC contractor serving Phoenix and Tucson. When summer temperatures hit 115 degrees, your AC is a lifeline. NATE-certified technicians install, repair, and maintain all major brands including Daikin, Trane, Carrier, Lennox, and Goodman.

#### AC Repair
Same-day emergency AC repair service. We diagnose and repair all makes and models including compressor failures, refrigerant leaks, capacitor replacements, fan motor issues, and thermostat problems. Available 7 days a week.

#### AC Installation
We install high-efficiency air conditioning systems from Daikin, Trane, Carrier, and Goodman. Every installation includes a Manual J load calculation, proper ductwork evaluation, and manufacturer warranty registration. Financing available starting at $89/month.

#### AC Maintenance
Bi-annual tune-ups include coil cleaning, refrigerant level checks, electrical connection inspection, thermostat calibration, and filter replacement. Regular maintenance extends system life by 5-7 years and prevents 95% of emergency breakdowns.

#### Heating Repair
We repair heat pumps, gas furnaces, and electric heaters. Common issues include ignitor failures, heat exchanger cracks, blower motor problems, and thermostat malfunctions.

#### Ductwork
Leaky ductwork wastes up to 30% of cooling energy in Arizona attics where temperatures exceed 150 degrees. We inspect, seal, repair, and replace ductwork.

#### Mini Split Systems
Ductless AC for room additions, garages, casitas, and problem rooms. We install single and multi-zone ductless systems from Daikin and Mitsubishi with SEER ratings up to 30.

#### Smart Thermostat Installation
We install and configure Ecobee, Nest, and Honeywell systems with proper C-wire connections and WiFi integration. Smart thermostats save 15-23% on cooling costs.

#### Indoor Air Quality
We install HEPA filtration systems, UV germicidal lights, whole-home humidifiers, and air purifiers that remove dust, allergens, bacteria, and VOCs.

#### Attic Insulation
Blown-in fiberglass and cellulose insulation to R-38 or higher, reducing AC strain and energy bills by 20-40%.

#### Spray Foam Insulation
Open-cell and closed-cell spray foam in attics, walls, rim joists, and crawl spaces for maximum energy efficiency. Highest R-value per inch and air-tight seal.

#### Radiant Barrier
Reflective attic barrier that reflects up to 97% of radiant heat, reducing attic temperatures by 20-30 degrees. Pays for itself in 2-3 years.

### 3. Plumbing & Water Heaters
Licensed plumbing and water heater services for homes and businesses. From emergency leak repairs to full re-pipes, tankless water heater installations, and water softener systems. Arizona's hard water, extreme heat, and aging infrastructure create unique plumbing challenges.

#### Water Heater Installation
Tank and tankless water heater installation from Rheem, AO Smith, Rinnai, and Navien. Arizona hard water shortens water heater life to 8-10 years. Tankless units provide endless hot water and save up to 30% on energy costs. Same-day installation available.

#### Water Heater Repair
Same-day diagnosis and repair for all water heater types. Common repairs include thermocouple replacement, element replacement, pilot light issues, and sediment flush.

#### Leak Detection & Repair
Electronic listening equipment and thermal imaging to locate hidden leaks under slabs, in walls, and underground without unnecessary demolition.

#### Drain Cleaning
Motorized drain snakes for simple clogs and hydro jetting (4,000 PSI) for stubborn blockages, grease buildup, and root intrusion.

#### Sewer Line Services
Sewer camera inspections, traditional dig repairs, trenchless pipe lining (cured-in-place), and pipe bursting for full replacement with minimal yard disruption.

#### Re-Piping
Whole-home copper and PEX re-piping for homes with polybutylene pipes. Most whole-home re-pipes completed in 1-2 days.

#### Fixture Installation
Kitchen and bathroom faucets, toilets, garbage disposals, dishwashers, washing machine hookups, and outdoor hose bibs.

#### Water Softener
Whole-home water softeners, reverse osmosis systems, and filtration units. Phoenix water hardness averages 15-25 grains per gallon.

#### Gas Line Services
Natural gas and propane line installation and repair for water heaters, furnaces, stoves, dryers, pool heaters, fire pits, and BBQ grills. All work includes pressure testing and leak detection.

### 4. Weed & Lawn Care
Professional weed control and lawn care for Arizona homes. Desert weeds like spurge, puncture vine, and bermuda grass invade yards year-round. Licensed technicians use targeted treatments to keep yards clean and weed-free.

#### Pre-Emergent Weed Control
Invisible barrier in soil prevents weed seeds from germinating. Applied in early fall and late winter. Commercial-grade products last 3-4 months per application.

#### Post-Emergent Weed Treatment
Targeted herbicides kill existing weeds at the root. Broadleaf treatments for dandelions and spurge, selective treatments for bermuda grass in turf, non-selective for gravel areas.

#### Gravel & Rock Yard Maintenance
Pre-emergent barriers combined with targeted post-emergent sprays to keep rock landscapes clean. Treats driveways, walkways, and entire rock yards.

#### Lawn Fertilization
Specialized Arizona feeding schedules: iron and nitrogen for summer bermuda, starter fertilizer for winter rye, and micronutrients for year-round health.

#### Bermuda Grass Control
Selective herbicides and root barrier treatments to contain or eliminate bermuda from flower beds, rock yards, and pavement cracks.

#### Overseeding
Winter rye grass seeding in October for year-round green lawns. Includes scalping, seeding, topdressing, and watering schedule.

#### Weed & Feed Program
Year-round service plan combining pre-emergent barriers, post-emergent treatments, seasonal fertilizer, and micronutrient supplements.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Pest Control
- **How often should I get pest control in Arizona?** Monthly or bi-monthly due to year-round pest pressure. Peak activity during monsoon (July-September) and spring (March-May).
- **Is pest control safe for kids and pets?** Yes, EPA-approved products applied strategically. Stay off treated exterior areas for 30 minutes.
- **Do you offer free pest inspections?** Yes, every new customer gets a free, no-obligation inspection.
- **What is your termite warranty?** Renewable warranty with annual re-inspections and retreatments as needed at no additional cost.

### HVAC
- **How much does AC repair cost in Phoenix?** Most repairs range $150-$600. Upfront pricing provided before work begins.
- **When should I replace my AC?** If 15+ years old, uses R-22 refrigerant, needs compressor replacement, or repair costs exceed 50% of new system.
- **Do you offer financing?** Yes, including 0% APR for qualified buyers and payments starting at $89/month.
- **How often should I service my AC?** Bi-annual maintenance recommended - spring and fall.

### Plumbing
- **Do you offer emergency plumbing?** Yes, same-day emergency service for active leaks, sewer backups, and burst pipes.
- **How long do water heaters last in Arizona?** Tank models 8-12 years, tankless 15-20 years. Annual flushing recommended.
- **Should I get a water softener?** Strongly recommended. Phoenix has 15-25 GPG hard water, among the hardest in the country.

### Weed Control
- **How often do I need weed control?** Every 6-8 weeks year-round. Arizona weeds grow in every season.
- **When should I overseed?** October 1-20 in Phoenix, slightly later in Tucson.
